description_en: Calls GetGateway to retrieve gateway information
name: GetGateway

parameters.help_en:
The instance ID.

You can view the ID of the current instance on the Instance Overview page in the IoT Platform console. If an ID value exists, you must specify this ID value. Otherwise, the call fails.

If the public instance does not have an ID value, refer to https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/267533.html
parameters.help_zh:
实例ID。
您可在物联网平台控制台的实例概览页面，查看当前实例的ID。若有ID值，必须传入该ID值，否则调用会失败。

如果公共实例没有ID值，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/267533.html
parameters.name: iot_instance_id

parameters.help_en: The unique identifier of the gateway
parameters.name: gw_eui

Address.description_en: The detailed address of the gateway

AddressCode.description_en: The region ID of the gateway location, as defined by `http://lbs.amap.com/api/javascript-api/download`

AuthTypes.description_en:
The contract type of the gateway. Valid values:

HYBRID: hybrid gateway.
SINGLE_CHANNEL: single-channel gateway.
STANDARD: standard contract gateway
AuthTypes.description_zh:
网关合约类型。

HYBRID：hybrid网关。
SINGLE_CHANNEL：单通道网关。
STANDARD：标准合约网关

ChargeStatus.description_en:
The overdue payment status of the gateway. Valid values:

NORMAL: The gateway has no overdue payment and is working properly.
ARREARAGE: The gateway has an overdue payment
ChargeStatus.description_zh:
网关欠费状态。

NORMAL：网关未欠费，正常工作。
ARREARAGE：网关欠费

City.description_en: The name of the city where the gateway is located

ClassBSupported.description_en: Indicates whether the gateway supports Class B mode
ClassBSupported.description_zh: 该网关是否支持Class B模式

ClassBWorking.description_en: Indicates whether the gateway is currently working in Class B mode
ClassBWorking.description_zh: 该网关是否正工作在Class B模式下

CommunicationMode.description_en:
The communication mode of the gateway. Valid values:

FULL_DUPLEX: full-duplex.

HALF_DUPLEX: half-duplex
CommunicationMode.description_zh:
网关通信模式。可取值为：

FULL_DUPLEX：全双工。

HALF_DUPLEX：半双工

Description.description_en: The custom description of the gateway

District.description_en: The name of the district where the gateway is located

Enabled.description_en:
Indicates whether the gateway is enabled. Valid values:

true: The gateway is enabled.

false: The gateway is disabled
Enabled.description_zh:
该网关是否处于启用状态。

true：启用状态。

false：停用状态

FreqBandPlanGroupId.description_en: The frequency band ID of the gateway

GisCoordinateSystem.description_en: The coordinate system used for the gateway longitude and latitude. Valid values: WGS_84, GCJ_02
GisCoordinateSystem.description_zh: 网关经纬度所采用的坐标系统，可取值：WGS_84, GCJ_02

GwEui.description_en: The unique identifier of the gateway

Name.description_en: The custom name of the gateway

OnlineState.description_en:
The online or offline status of the gateway. Valid values:

ONLINE: online.

OFFLINE: offline
OnlineState.description_zh:
网关的在线、离线状态。

ONLINE：在线。

OFFLINE：离线

OnlineStateChangedMillis.description_en:
The time when the online or offline status last changed.

The value is a UNIX timestamp in milliseconds
OnlineStateChangedMillis.description_zh:
最近一次在线、离线状态的变更时间。

格式为UNIX时间戳，以毫秒为单位

TimeCorrectable.description_en: Indicates whether the gateway can be used as a time calibration gateway
TimeCorrectable.description_zh: 该网关是否可以作为时间校准网关

Success.description_en: Indicates whether the call was successful
